description: This PHP source file defines the HolidayAPI class within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It provides RESTful API endpoints to manage holiday data, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting holiday entries. The class implements CRUD operations and integrates validation, documentation annotations, and service layer interactions for holiday data.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Leave\Api\HolidayAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class for handling holiday data in the leave module of OrangeHRM. Implements CRUD endpoints, validation, and documentation for managing holiday entries.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific holiday by its ID, returning a HolidayModel wrapped in EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getIdFromUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts the holiday ID from URL parameters.

methods.name: getIdParamRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule ensuring the ID parameter is a positive integer.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single holiday.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all holidays filtered by date range, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing holidays.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new holiday entry based on request body parameters and returns the created holiday model.

methods.name: setHolidayParams
methods.description: Populates a Holiday entity's properties from request body parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a holiday.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for holiday request bodies.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing holiday identified by ID with new attributes from request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a holiday.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple holidays specified by IDs in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rule for delete operation confirming ID array.
